## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù is a *mò fǎ*-genre (decline-of-Dharma) sūtra prophesying the changes (*biàn* 變) that will come in the latter days of the Dharma. The work is one of the foundational *mò fǎ* texts in the Chinese canon.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to Zhú Fǎhù's Cháng'ān period (266–313 CE).
